segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Incircle and three Excircles are the four tritangent circles tangent to all three sidelines of triangle A B C. The interior angle bisectors concur at the Incenter X one, while the exterior angle bisectors meet at the three excenters J A, J B, and J C.
